title: Oravel Stays (OYO) IPO
summary: Oravel Stays (OYO) IPO is a book-built issue of about ₹6,650 crore, proposed to be listed on BSE and NSE. The IPO dates, price band and lot size are yet to be announced.

b.p: Oravel Stays (OYO) IPO has a total issue size of ₹6,650 Crores Approx. and will be listed on BSE, NSE. Price band & Lot size details are yet to be announced.

Oravel Stays (OYO) financials show revenue growth and profitability trends over recent years, indicating business stability.

OYO (OYO Hotels & Homes) - popularly known as OYO Rooms - is an Indian multinational company in the hospitality sector, with a vast chain of leased and franchised hotels, vacation homes, and living spaces spread across the globe. It symbolizes the success of a startup in the travel & hospitality space in India. · It is a highly advanced technology-based platform which, in turn, helps support and further sustain the highly fragmented hospitality sector around the world. · The group provides different types of stays, which are OYO Rooms, OYO Townhouse, Oyo Homes and Vacation Homes, and SilverKey/Capital O/Palette, etc.
Ritesh Agarwal, Ra Hospitality Holdings (Cayman), Svf India Holdings (Cayman) Limited are the company's promoters of Oravel Stays (OYO).
